biotools.summary: CUPID is a computational pipeline designed to link antimicrobial resistance genes to their specific bacterial hosts and genomic context using methylation patterns derived from Nanopore metagenomic sequencing data. It extends association analysis from assembled genomes to individual contigs and reads to improve accuracy in clinical surveillance settings.
biotools.name: CUPID: Contig and Read Based Plasmid-Host Association
